item.title: "review this script" claims that no script is attached
item.body:
Type: Bug Today's patch for GitHub CoPilot 1.335.0 broke code review. All attempts to review an open script give this incorrect message, despite the script being open and added to the context list. This is new behavior that began immediately after the extension update on June 13, 2025: > It appears you have not attached or pasted a script for review. > Please paste your script or specify the filename if it’s in your workspace, and I’ll review it for clarity, correctness, and best practices. comments.body: Hi, we have made a lot of changes over the past several months, and the newer models have improved as well. If you are still encountering this problem on the latest VS Code and Copilot Chat extension, please file a new issue in the [microsoft/vscode](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode) repository.
